item.text:
Top finding: upstream Harbor 0.23.0 never reads mini-swe-agent's native `info.exit_status` — normal submission, internal limits, and giving up are indistinguishable in `result.json`/Miles metadata. Only the native trajectory file and the tee'd log discriminate them.

Files: [mini_swe_agent.py](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/agents/installed/mini_swe_agent.py) (`mini:`), [installed/base.py](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/agents/installed/base.py) (`ibase:`), [trial.py](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/trial/trial.py), [harbor_agent_function.py](/app/reference/miles/examples/experimental/harbor/harbor_agent_function.py) (`miles:`).

## 1. Files and schemas

The run is one blocking in-sandbox exec: `mini-swe-agent --yolo --model=… --task=… --output=/logs/agent/mini-swe-agent.trajectory.json … --exit-immediately 2>&1 </dev/null | tee /logs/agent/mini-swe-agent.txt` ([mini_swe_agent.py:842](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/agents/installed/mini_swe_agent.py:842)). `/logs/agent` is mounted from `trial_dir/agent/` ([paths.py:39](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/models/trial/paths.py:39), [paths.py:198](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/models/trial/paths.py:198)). So `agent/` contains:

- `mini-swe-agent.trajectory.json` — native, written by the binary ([mini_swe_agent.py:674](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/agents/installed/mini_swe_agent.py:674)).
- `mini-swe-agent.txt` — tee'd stdout+stderr of the whole run.
- `trajectory.json` — ATIF, written host-side post-run by `populate_context_post_run` → `convert_and_save_trajectory` ([mini_swe_agent.py:719](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/agents/installed/mini_swe_agent.py:719), [mini_swe_agent.py:437](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/agents/installed/mini_swe_agent.py:437)). Absent if native file missing/corrupt/conversion fails (failures only debug-logged, [mini_swe_agent.py:689](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/agents/installed/mini_swe_agent.py:689), [mini_swe_agent.py:728](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/agents/installed/mini_swe_agent.py:728)).
- `setup/` dir (created, may be empty) ([base.py:1046](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/agents/installed/base.py:1046)).

Trial root: `result.json` (singular; [paths.py:289](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/models/trial/paths.py:289), written [trial.py:470](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/trial/trial.py:470)), `exception.txt`, `trial.log`, `config.json`.

Native schema, as consumed by the converter (the binary is external — `uv tool install mini-swe-agent`, [mini_swe_agent.py:667](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/agents/installed/mini_swe_agent.py:667) — so this is the subset Harbor reads; other native keys like `info.exit_status`/`submission` pass through unread):

- Top: `{trajectory_format, info: {mini_version, model_stats: {instance_cost}, config: {model: {model_name}, agent: {...}}}, messages: [...]}` ([mini_swe_agent.py:279](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/agents/installed/mini_swe_agent.py:279)).
- Chat-completions messages: `role` ∈ system/user/assistant/tool, `content` (str or parts list), assistant `tool_calls: [{id, function: {name, arguments}}]`, usage at `extra.response.usage {prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, prompt_tokens_details{cached_tokens}, completion_tokens_details{reasoning_tokens}}`, timestamps from `created_at|timestamp|completed_at|extra.timestamp` ([mini_swe_agent.py:75](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/agents/installed/mini_swe_agent.py:75), [mini_swe_agent.py:88](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/agents/installed/mini_swe_agent.py:88)).
- Responses-API messages: `object: "response"`, top-level `usage {input_tokens, output_tokens, …}`, `output: [{type: message|reasoning|function_call}]`, tool results as `{type: function_call_output, output, call_id, extra.raw_output}` ([mini_swe_agent.py:99](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/agents/installed/mini_swe_agent.py:99), [mini_swe_agent.py:211](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/agents/installed/mini_swe_agent.py:211), [mini_swe_agent.py:356](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/agents/installed/mini_swe_agent.py:356)).

ATIF `trajectory.json`: `{schema_version: "ATIF-v1.7", session_id, agent: {name: "mini-swe-agent", version: mini_version, model_name, extra: {original_format, agent_config}}, steps, final_metrics, notes}` ([mini_swe_agent.py:417](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/agents/installed/mini_swe_agent.py:417)). Each agent `Step`: `step_id` (sequential from 1, includes system/user steps), `timestamp` (ISO or null — passthrough only, no duration), `source`, `model_name`, `message`, `reasoning_content`, `tool_calls: [{tool_call_id, function_name, arguments}]`, `observation: {results: [{content, source_call_id}]}` (later user/tool messages fold into the previous agent step), `metrics: {prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, cached_tokens, cost_usd, extra{*_details}}`, `llm_call_count: 1` ([mini_swe_agent.py:326](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/agents/installed/mini_swe_agent.py:326), [step.py:14](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/models/trajectories/step.py:14)). Caveats: `metrics` is null when both token counts are 0 ([mini_swe_agent.py:150](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/agents/installed/mini_swe_agent.py:150)); per-step `cost_usd` is fabricated by apportioning `instance_cost` by completion-token share, not measured ([mini_swe_agent.py:153](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/agents/installed/mini_swe_agent.py:153)). `final_metrics`: `total_prompt_tokens`, `total_completion_tokens`, `total_cached_tokens`, `total_cost_usd` (= `instance_cost`), `total_steps = len(steps)`, `extra.total_reasoning_tokens` ([mini_swe_agent.py:403](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/agents/installed/mini_swe_agent.py:403)). No per-step timing/duration anywhere upstream.

## 2. Exit statuses by failure mode

There are three layers; only the first has a mini-native `exit_status`, and Harbor drops it ([mini_swe_agent.py:685](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/agents/installed/mini_swe_agent.py:685) reads only tokens + `instance_cost`). The exact native strings are not in this reference (external binary); an observer must read `info.*` in `mini-swe-agent.trajectory.json` directly.

- Normal submission, step/cost limits, format-error loops, giving up: binary exits 0 (Harbor passes `--exit-immediately`; sole limit knob is `cost_limit`, default `"0"`, [mini_swe_agent.py:475](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/agents/installed/mini_swe_agent.py:475); no step-limit option exists). Harbor records nothing: `exception_info = null`, verifier runs. Miles maps "no exception + verifier_result present" → `"Submitted"` ([harbor_agent_function.py:406](/app/reference/miles/examples/experimental/harbor/harbor_agent_function.py:406)) — so all four collapse to `Submitted` + reward. Format errors are visible only as observation messages in the trajectory.
- LLM/exec errors that make the binary exit non-zero: `exec_as_agent` raises via regex classification over stdout+stderr, last match wins ([base.py:875](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/agents/installed/base.py:875), [base.py:946](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/agents/installed/base.py:946)): `ApiRateLimitError`, `ApiUsageLimitError`, `ApiInternalServerError`, `ApiOverloadedError`, `ApiConnectionClosedError`, `ApiResponseStalledError`, `OutputTokenExceededError`, `ContextWindowExceededError`, `AgentAuthenticationError`, `ModelNotFoundError`, `ApiProviderResourceNotFoundError`, `AgentSafetyRefusalError`, `UnknownApiError` (bare `API Error`), `NetworkConnectionError`, else generic `NonZeroAgentExitCodeError` with message `Command failed (exit N): …stdout/stderr…` ([base.py:453](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/agents/installed/base.py:453)). The patterns are phrased for other CLIs (`API Error: 500…`); raw litellm tracebacks from mini will usually land in the generic bucket unless they hit e.g. `rate.?limit`, `invalid_api_key`, `Connection refused`. `SingleStepTrial` catches these, records `exception_info {exception_type, exception_message, exception_traceback, occurred_at}` + `exception.txt`, and still runs the verifier ([single_step.py:84](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/trial/single_step.py:84), [trial.py:473](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/trial/trial.py:473)).
- Timeouts inside a step: upstream has **no polling**. One exec, no `timeout_sec` ([mini_swe_agent.py:842](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/agents/installed/mini_swe_agent.py:842); default `None`, [base.py:986](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/agents/installed/base.py:986)); per-LLM-call litellm timeout forced to 3600s ([mini_swe_agent.py:37](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/agents/installed/mini_swe_agent.py:37), [mini_swe_agent.py:767](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/agents/installed/mini_swe_agent.py:767)). A hung LLM call or bash command is invisible until the trial-level `asyncio.wait_for` fires → `AgentTimeoutError: Agent execution timed out after X seconds` ([trial.py:554](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/trial/trial.py:554)), killing the binary mid-step; native trajectory may be partial/missing (tolerated, [mini_swe_agent.py:689](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/agents/installed/mini_swe_agent.py:689)). Miles: `AgentTimeoutError|VerifierTimeoutError|EnvironmentStartTimeoutError` → `TimeLimitExceeded`, plus its own 7200s wall-clock `wait_for` → `TimeLimitExceeded` with no verdict ([harbor_agent_function.py:85](/app/reference/miles/examples/experimental/harbor/harbor_agent_function.py:85), [harbor_agent_function.py:467](/app/reference/miles/examples/experimental/harbor/harbor_agent_function.py:467)). Note `AgentSetupTimeoutError` ([trial.py:1578](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/trial/trial.py:1578)) is *not* in Miles' timeout set → `AgentError`.
- Miles vocabulary overall (sample metadata, not trial files): `Submitted`, `TimeLimitExceeded`, `SequenceLengthLimitExceeded` (branch-only `MaxSeqLenExceededError`/`SingleTurnMaxSeqLenExceededError`, [harbor_agent_function.py:86](/app/reference/miles/examples/experimental/harbor/harbor_agent_function.py:86)), else `AgentError` — including "no exception but no verifier_result" and any exception escaping `Trial.run()` ([harbor_agent_function.py:398](/app/reference/miles/examples/experimental/harbor/harbor_agent_function.py:398), [harbor_agent_function.py:476](/app/reference/miles/examples/experimental/harbor/harbor_agent_function.py:476)).

## 3. Policy vs infra from trial-dir files only

Policy failure: `result.json.exception_info = null`; `agent_execution` has both timestamps; `verifier_result` present (reward 0); both trajectory files present and parseable; tokens > 0. Diagnosis is in the steps: bad `tool_calls`, repeated identical commands, repeated format-error observations, very few steps then a final no-tool-call agent message, or a long trajectory ending without submission evidence. Confirm against native `info.exit_status` in `mini-swe-agent.trajectory.json` (present in file, unused by Harbor).

Infra/harness failure, by signal:

- Install failure: `exception_info` set during prepare; `agent_setup` timing present but `agent_execution = null`, `agent_result = null` (only created at [trial.py:509](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/trial/trial.py:509)), verifier never runs; no `mini-swe-agent.txt` or trajectories. `exception_type`: `NonZeroAgentExitCodeError`/`RuntimeError("Agent install failed: …")` ([base.py:1049](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/agents/installed/base.py:1049)) or `AgentSetupTimeoutError`; env problems → `EnvironmentStartTimeoutError`.
- LLM endpoint failure: `exception_type` in the `Api*`/`NetworkConnectionError`/`AgentAuthenticationError`/`ModelNotFoundError` family (or generic `NonZeroAgentExitCodeError` wrapping a litellm traceback); tail of `mini-swe-agent.txt` holds the provider error; native trajectory missing or stuck at system/user; tokens 0/null in `agent_result`. Pre-exec misconfiguration (no API key, model not `provider/model`) → `ValueError`, no `mini-swe-agent.txt` ([mini_swe_agent.py:748](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/agents/installed/mini_swe_agent.py:748), [mini_swe_agent.py:758](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/agents/installed/mini_swe_agent.py:758)).
- Sandbox exec failure: `environment.exec` itself raising propagates unclassified (backend exception type in `exception_type`, not the `Command failed (exit N)` message shape); logs truncated or unsynced.
- Binary crash mid-run: generic `NonZeroAgentExitCodeError`; Python traceback at tail of `mini-swe-agent.txt`; native trajectory partial/missing. Diagnostic asymmetries: native present + tokens populated but `trajectory.json` absent = ATIF conversion failed post-run ([mini_swe_agent.py:714](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/agents/installed/mini_swe_agent.py:714) runs before [mini_swe_agent.py:722](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/agents/installed/mini_swe_agent.py:722)); native corrupt = early return, tokens all null ([mini_swe_agent.py:695](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/agents/installed/mini_swe_agent.py:695)).

Ambiguous cases: `AgentTimeoutError` — policy stall (looping long command) vs infra hang (endpoint stalled up to the 3600s litellm cap); disambiguate via last step's command/timestamp and `mini-swe-agent.txt` tail. Miles deliberately scores it 0 ("The policy may be what is stalling", [harbor_agent_function.py:472](/app/reference/miles/examples/experimental/harbor/harbor_agent_function.py:472)). `AgentSafetyRefusalError` and `ContextWindowExceededError` are policy/deterministic outcomes despite sitting in the error family ([base.py:132](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/agents/installed/base.py:132)). Miles has no infra-discard path yet — everything non-verdict scores 0 ([harbor_agent_function.py:55](/app/reference/miles/examples/experimental/harbor/harbor_agent_function.py:55)).

## 4. `result.json` `agent_result`/`metadata`

`TrialResult.agent_result` is an `AgentContext`: `{n_input_tokens (incl. cache), n_cache_tokens, n_output_tokens, cost_usd, model_usage, rollout_details, metadata}` ([result.py:70](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/models/trial/result.py:70), [context.py:21](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/models/agent/context.py:21)). For mini-swe-agent upstream: only the first four are set, summed from native messages + `instance_cost` ([mini_swe_agent.py:701](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/agents/installed/mini_swe_agent.py:701)); `metadata` and `rollout_details` stay null; there is no `n_steps` field on upstream `AgentContext` at all. `model_usage` is backfilled by Trial from the ATIF file, keyed by model name ([trial.py:942](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/trial/trial.py:942), [trajectory_utils.py:51](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/utils/trajectory_utils.py:51)). Population runs in a `finally` even after timeout/non-zero exit, so partial counts are possible ([single_step.py:86](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/trial/single_step.py:86)); if the native file is missing/corrupt, the `AgentContext` object exists with all fields null. Miles' `agent_metrics` = those token/cost fields + `turns` from `agent_result.n_steps` (always absent upstream for mini) + `**agent_result.metadata` (empty upstream) + phase durations from the `TimingInfo`s ([harbor_agent_function.py:415](/app/reference/miles/examples/experimental/harbor/harbor_agent_function.py:415)).

## What upstream 0.23.0 lacks vs the Miles harbor branch

Per [harbor_agent_function.py:11](/app/reference/miles/examples/experimental/harbor/harbor_agent_function.py:11): mini-swe-agent `poll_steps` (listed as needed — upstream run is a single unpolled exec with conversion only after exit, so no mid-run step observation/caps), output/trajectory caps and per-step timing feeding `agent_metrics` (upstream: only `cost_limit` + per-call `max_tokens` options, [mini_swe_agent.py:475](/app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/agents/installed/mini_swe_agent.py:475); no timing beyond message timestamps; no `n_steps`/`metadata` population), `max_seq_len` enforcement with `MaxSeqLenExceededError`/`SingleTurnMaxSeqLenExceededError` (Miles passes `max_seq_len`/`model_info` kwargs at [harbor_agent_function.py:353](/app/reference/miles/examples/experimental/harbor/harbor_agent_function.py:353), which have no counterpart in upstream `MiniSweAgentOptions`), plus terminus-2 `response_length_exceeded_policy` and claude-code `n_steps`. The `poll_steps`/caps implementations themselves are not in this reference tree — only the docstring claims and their consumption points above are verifiable here.

Role: mini-swe-agent harness reader
Objective: Read /app/reference/harbor-0.23.0/harbor/agents/installed/mini_swe_agent.py fully, plus harbor/agents/installed/base.py as needed, and the Miles file /app/reference/miles/examples/experimental/harbor/harbor_agent_function.py comments about mini-swe-agent (poll_steps, caps, agent_metrics). Answer: (1) where mini-swe-agent writes its trajectory/output in a trial dir (filenames under agent/), and the JSON schema (keys for steps/messages, exit status, token counts, per-step timing); (2) what exit_status / error strings it records for: normal submission, step/cost limits, format errors, LLM errors, environment/exec errors, timeouts inside a step (poll behavior); (3) how an observer with only trial-dir files can distinguish policy failures (bad actions, format loops, giving up) from harness/infra failures (install failure, LLM endpoint errors, sandbox exec failures, agent binary crash); what fields signal each; (4) what result.json agent_result/metadata contains for mini-swe-agent. Note anything the reference (upstream 0.23.0) lacks that Miles' harbor branch adds per harbor_agent_function.py docstring. Cite file:line. Do not edit anything.
